episodes.title: Who Is Mark? 16 Years In A Cult
episodes.description:
For 16 years, I lived inside a high-control group. Today, from a wheelchair in stroke rehab, I’m showing you the exact psychological mechanics they used—and how that same invisible grip is running through your smartphone.
